rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Meta-frame lectures are closers, not openers.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Surface is a supplementary reading (curriculum/CLAUDE.md's fourth student-facing type), not a lecture; the rule's opener/closer placement diagnostic targets lectures that name a pattern the student already lived through. This file explicitly withholds the pattern name (Ronacher's three-pattern) reserved for M5's own closer, so it does not commit the failure mode the rule guards against even though the rule itself doesn't bind this file type.
